body.message:
These are standard replacement charges, which are in line with the practices followed by most apartment rental providers. As a fair resolution, we have given you the option to purchase the same replacement item at your own cost instead of applying our standard replacement charge.

Please note that many other companies would simply deduct the replacement cost directly from the security deposit after check-out without offering this option.

We believe our proposed resolution is fair to both parties and appreciate your kind understanding and cooperation.
